Paṭikūlañca jegucchaṃ, duggandhañca virūpakaṃ;Harāyitamajaññañca, hīḷitaṃ vikkhitāsivaṃ.
Sabhāvo sopi dehassa,Sabbassāpi ca sabbathā;Vicitabbā dhirenāpi,Esāyaṃ niyatā gati.
Jīvamānopi kāyoyaṃ,Kuṇapova sabhāvato;Tamalaṅkārapaṭicchanno,Bālānaṃ na pakāsati.
Bahi maṭṭhamupaṭṭhāti, anto kuṇapapūritaṃ;Uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, navadvāramalassavaṃ.
Sarīraṃ niccaduggandhaṃ, nānākimisamākulaṃ;Tacamaṃsapaṭicchannaṃ, aṭṭhipañjarasaṇṭhitaṃ.
Vaccakūpamidaṃ nāma, dvattiṃsāsucipūritaṃ;Narānukkārabhūmīva, nekavassagaṇocitā.
Nānābyādhisamākiṇṇaṃ, nānopaddavasaṃkulaṃ;Nānānatthasamodhānaṃ, nānāsaṃklesavatthukaṃ.
Positampi ciraṃ kālaṃ, mamaṃkāramamāyitaṃ;Lahudujjanamittova, pīḷitaṃ sampadussati.
Parihāyati nissāraṃ, jaratāpi taṃ yobbanaṃ;Maccubhajjitamaccanta-masesaṃ paribhijjati.
Tathāpi jālasantāno, bahusambhārasaṅkhato;Vatthālaṅkārasañchanno, mālāgandhādisobhito.
Saviññattivikārehi, vicittākāramaṇḍito;Kāyo līḷavilāsehi, palambheti mahājanaṃ.
Vañcitā yena dummedhā, kāmaklesamalīmayā;Pūrenti caturāpāyaṃ, māradheyyānusārino.
Evamādīnavaṃ ñatvā, pūtikāye vicakkhaṇā;Asubhādikamākāra-mārabbha chandupaṭṭhahuṃ.

Satthavāho mahāyoggo, maggāmaggayudhandharo;Sirisatthamadhiggayha, vicarittha mahāpathaṃ,
Anomo asamo dhīro,Lokahītaparakkamo;Sabbākāravaropeto,Accherabbhutapuggalo.
Ānubhāvavasippatto, āsabhaṇḍānaniccalo;Mahantamariyādoyamanantagatigocaro.
Appameyyo mahānāgo, mahāvīro mahāmuni;Mahesī mahitācāro, mahāmaho mahiddhiko.
Byāmappabhāparikkhitto, ketumālāhalaṅkato;Dvattiṃsalakkhaṇāsītianubyañjanasobhito.
Chabbaṇṇaraṃsilalito, ratanagghiyasannibho;Samiddhirūpasobhaggo, dassaneyyaṃva piṇḍitaṃ.
Phullaṃ padumasaṇḍaṃva, kapparukkhovalaṅkato;Nabhaṃva tārakākiṇṇaṃ, uttamo paṭidissati.
Niddhotamalacandova, nakkhattaparivārito;Khattasaṅghaparibyuḷho, cakkavattīva sobhati.
Taṇhādaliddanāsāya, manorathasamiddhiyā;Kālantaramanāgamma, paccakkhaphaladāyako.
Upanissayavantānaṃ, ‘‘ehi passā’’ti dassiyo;Paccattameva viññūhi, veditabbo sabhāvato.
Sabbāsavasamugghātī, suddho sovatthiko sivo;Pihitāpāyakummaggo, maggo nibbānapattiyā.
Klesasaṃkaṭaduggamhā, dukkhakkhandhamahabbhayā;Khemantabhūmiṃ niyyāti, accantamanupaddavaṃ
Caturoghanimuggānaṃ, setubandho samuggato;Bhavacārakaruddhānaṃ, mahādvāro apāruto.
Sokopāyāsaviddhānaṃ, paridevasamaṅginaṃ;Sallanīharaṇopāyo, accantasukhamīrito.
Byasanopaddavāpeto, saṃklesamalanissaṭo;Ujusammattaniyato, paṭipattivisuddhiyā.
Suddhasīlaparikkhāro, samādhimayapañjaro;Sammāsaṅkappacakkaṅgo, sammāvāyāmavāhano.
Vipattipaṭibāhāya, sabbasampattisiddhiyā;Sabbakhandhavimokkhāya, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā.
Cattāro ca paṭipannā, cattāro ca phale ṭhitā;Esa saṅgho ujubhūto, paññāsīlasamāhito.
Pahīnāpāyagamano, pāpaklesavinissaṭo;Paripanthasamucchedī, bhavacārakabhedako.
Uttamadamathappatto, suvinīto mahesinā;Vijjāvimuttivodāto, ājānīyapathe ṭhito.
Sugatorasi sambhūto, sucidhammasirindharo;Paṭipāditasampatto, dhammasāsanasevito.
Appamādaparittāṇo, sīlālaṅkārabhūsito;Cetosamādhisannaddho, paññāyudhasamujjalo.
Ujumaggamadhiṭṭhāya, mārakāyappadālano;Aparājitasaṅgāmo, lalitodātavikkamo.
Yaṃ phalaṃ paribhuñjantā, vimuttirasasevanaṃ;Accantasukhitā dhīrā, bhavanti ajarāmarā.
Taṃ phalaṃ patthayantena, saṅghānussatibhāvanā;Bhāvetabbā paniccevamiti bhāsanti paṇḍitā.
Evametesu yaṃ kiñci, samādāya rahogato;Tamānisaṃsaṃ guṇato, phalato ca vicintaye.
Ādi cetaṃ patiṭṭhā ca, mukhaṃ pamukhamuttamaṃ;Mūlaṃ kusaladhammānaṃ, pabhavaṃ paṭipattiyā.
Sāsanotaraṇadvāraṃ, titthaṃ saddhammavāpiyā;Pārisuddhipadaṭṭhānaṃ, maggo khemantapāpako.
Sādhu sikkhāsamādānaṃ, bāhusaccavibhūsanaṃ;Ariyācāracāritta-mavaṇṇamalavajjanaṃ.
Pacchānutāpaharaṇaṃ, pītipāmojjavaḍḍhanaṃ;Nekkhammabhāvanopetaṃ, pabbajjāvesasobhanaṃ.
Sopānaṃ saggalokassa, daḷhāpāyavidhānakaṃ;Anupaddavasampatti, samatthaguṇasūdanī.
Klesapañjaravicchedi, vipattipathavāraṇaṃ;Sotthikammasamuṭṭhānaṃ, asādhāraṇamaṅgalaṃ.
‘‘Dullabho vata me laddho,Mahālābho anappako;Yohamakkhalitācāro,Upaghātavivajjito.
‘‘Dhammaṅkuritasantāno, mūlajātosmi sāsane;Ujumaggaṃ samāruḷho, pihitā sabhayā disā.
‘‘Avañcā vata me jāti, āraddhā khaṇasampadā;Patiṭṭhitomhi saddhamme, saphalaṃ mama jīvitaṃ
Saddhāya sīlavantesu, datvā dānaṃ yathārahaṃ;Niddhotamalamacchero, vivitto tamanussare.
Dānaṃ nidhānamanugaṃ, asādhāraṇamuttamaṃ;Avināsasukhādhānaṃ, accantaṃ sabbakāmadaṃ.
Kopadāhopasamanaṃ, maccheramalasodhanaṃ;Pamādaniddāvuṭṭhānaṃ, lobhapāsavimocanaṃ.
Cetovikāradamanaṃ, micchāmagganivāraṇaṃ;Vittilābhasukhassādo, vibhavodayamaṅgalaṃ.
Saddhādiguṇavodānaṃ, ajjhāsayavikāsanaṃ;Satācāraparikkhāro, tanucetovibhūsanaṃ.
Appamaññāpadaṭṭhānaṃ, appameyyena vaṇṇitaṃ;Mahāpurisacārittaṃ, sapadānaṃ mahesinā.
Dhammādhigatabhogānaṃ, sārādānamanuttaraṃ;Mahattādhigamūpāyaṃ, lokasantatikāraṇaṃ.
Atthakārī ca sammāhaṃ, pariccāgasamāyuto;Attano ca paresañca, hitāya paṭipannakā.
Sīlavantapatiṭṭhosmi, kapaṇānaṃ parāyaṇo;Buddhasāsanupaṭṭhāko, ñātimittopajīviko.
‘‘Saṃsāraddhānapātheyyaṃ, sabbadukkhavinodanaṃ;Subandhaṃ mama sabbattha, gahito ca kaṭagga
Taduttariñca ye devā, dibbakāyamadhiṭṭhitā;Tepi saddhādidhammesu, cirakālaṃ patiṭṭhitā.
Dibbasampattisampattā, nānābhogasamappitā;Pālento dīghamaddhānaṃ, anubhonti mahāsukhaṃ.
Niccamohitasotosmi,Tathāgatasubhāsite;Sutabhājanabhūto ca,Satimā susamāhito.
Maccheramalanittiṇṇo, lobhakkhandhavimuccito;Opānabhūto lokasmiṃ, vissaṭṭhasukhayācano.
Samārādhitasaddhammo, katapuññamahussavo;Devadhammasamiddhosmi, kalyāṇacaritākaro.
Vaṭṭānubandhavicchedo, bhavataṇhāvisosanaṃ;Sabbūpadhisamugghāto, dukkhanibbāpanaṃ sukhaṃ.
Palibodhasamucchedo, papañcaviniveṭhanaṃ;Sabbasaṅkhārasamatho, sabbalokavinissaṭo.
Bhāvanāmayametañca, katvā puññamanappakaṃ;Vāsanāgatisampatti-bhogabhāgīti vuccati.
Upanissayasampanno, patvā nibbedhamuttamaṃ;Diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaggiṃ, nibbāpeti anāsavo.
Purakkhatvāva maraṇaṃ, jāyanti paṭisandhiyaṃ;Jātā puna marissanti, evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino.
Athāvassaṃ maranteva, jiṇṇā daṇḍaparāyaṇā;Sūrā puññabalatthāmā, nānābyādhinipīḷitā.
Ajja suveti maraṇaṃ, pariyesati pāṇino;Senā yuddhapayātāva, sabbe maccubhayākulā.
Sattāratanalaṅkārā, caturiddhisamuggatā;Cakkavattī mahātejā, rājamaṇḍalasobhino.
Accantarāyabahulo, maraṇāhitasambhavo;Niccaṃ cakkasamāruḷho, lokoyaṃ parivattati.
Etthantare maraṇassa, vemajjhe mama vattato;Assāsepi avissaṭṭhe, jīvikā ce kathāva kā.
Vajjhappatto mahācoro,Niyyātāghātanaṃ yathā;Maraṇāya payātohaṃ,Tathevamanivattiyo.
Ambujova vaṅkaghasto, tāṇaleṇavivajjito;Niccaṃ maccuvasaṃ yanto, vissaṭṭho kimahaṃ care.
Ko me hāso kimānando,Kimahaṃ mohapāruto;Madappamādavikkhitto,Vicarāmi niraṅkuso?
Handāhamārabhissāmi, sammāsambuddhasāsane;Ātāpī pahitatto ca, hirottappasamāhito.
Paṭipattiparo hutvā, pāpadhammaniraṅkato;Nibbāpayāmi accantaṃ, sabbadukkhahutāvahaṃ.
Tadetaṃ pana bhāvetvā, upacārasamāhito;Nibbedabahulo hoti, appamādadhurandharo.
Micchādhammaṃ virājetvā, nandirāganirālayo;Sabbāsavaparikkhīṇo, pappoti amataṃ padaṃ.
Kāye bāttiṃsa koṭṭhāsā,Kuṇapāva samussitā;Sāragayhūpagāpetā,Dhikkatā dhīrahīḷitā.
Asubhāva paṭikkūlā, jegucchā sucivajjitā;Ninditā cakkhumantehi, andhabālopalāḷitā.
Vicittachavisañchannā, tacabhattasamohitā;Parissavaparikliṭṭhā, kuthitā pūtigandhitā.
Ahaṃkāramamattena, vissaṭṭhasukhasaṅgahā;Saṅghāṭaghanasambaddhā, sammohenti mahājanaṃ.
Chandarāgasamūpetā, yattha muḷhā puthujjanā;Sevanti visamaṃ ghoraṃ, caturāpāyabhāgino.
Dasadhābhogamiccevaṃ, katvā bhāvayato pana;Santibhūtā pakāsenti, rathacakkārasādisā.
Hitvā appaguṇe tattha, gaṇhaṃ suppaguṇaṃ budho;Appanaṃ paṭibhāgañca, pappotekekavatthusu.
Nīlādivaṇṇamārabbha, paṭibhāgo yadā tadā;Nīlādikasiṇaṃ hutvā, pañcakajjhānikaṃ bhave.
Kāmabandhavinimutto, pāpā medhāvi nissaṭo;Sacchikatvāna sāmaññaṃ, amataṃ paribhuñjati.
Ānāpānassatiṃ nāma, sammāsambuddhavaṇṇitaṃ;Kammaṭṭhānādhirājānaṃ, bhāvento pana paṇḍito.
Appanañcopacārañca, samathañca vipassanaṃ;Lokuttaraṃ lokiyañca, sukhenevādhigacchati.
Sukhumā nipuṇā tikkhā, paripakkā bale ṭhitā;Bodhipakkhiyadhammā ca, vodāyanti visesato.
Pārisuddhi tato pacchā, tesañca paṭipassanā;Iccevamaṭṭhadhā bhedā, mātikāyaṃ pakāsitā.
Pañcannaṃ na ṭhapetabbaṃ, heṭṭhā na dasatopari;Netabbamanupubbena, gaṇetabbamakhaṇḍitaṃ.

Bhūmidhamme yathābhūtaṃ, vipassitvā visārado;Appetānuttarajjhāna-mayaṃ suddhivipassanā.
Dīghamassāsapassāsā, rassaṃ vātha tathā dvayaṃ;Satimā matisampanno, paṭhamaṃ parigaṇhati.

Pakkhandanapariccāgapaṭinissaggato pana;Paṭinissaggānupassī, sikkhatīti pavuccati.
Ānāpānamukheneva, bhūmidhammavipassanā;Dhammānupassanā nāma, bhāsitevaṃ catubbidhā.
Iti soḷasadhākāraṃ, sikkhattayapatiṭṭhitaṃ;Catubbidhampi pūreti, satipaṭṭhānabhāvanaṃ.

Apāyekāyano maggo, pāpakaṇṭakabandhako;Dhammamaggasamucchedī, maggadvārapidhānako.
Sabbakalyāṇadhammānaṃ, avamaṅgalamuṭṭhitaṃ;Hitārambhasamugghātī, antarāyasamāgamo.
Sabbākārapaṭikkūlaṃ, sabbaviddesakāraṇaṃ;Vipattimukhamuppannaṃ, amittajanapatthitaṃ.
Sapattakaraṇaṃ ghoraṃ, sabbānatthavidhāyakaṃ;Bhayamantarato jātaṃ, taṃ jano nāvabujjhati.
Khuradhāraṃ lihantāva, gilantāva hutāsanaṃ;Tittalābuṃva khādantā, gaṇhantādittamāyudhaṃ.
Nāvabujjhanti dummedhā, cetosaṅkappavāyunā;Ukkāmukhāmivāditta-mujjalantā punappunaṃ.
Bhayamaggasamāruḷhā, khemamaggavirodhino;Byāpannā kibbisākiṇṇā, atthadvayavirodhino.
Duppaṭippāditārambhā, kodhasaṅkhobhamohitā;Dhammāmatarasassādaṃ, na vindanti aviddasu.
Kodhānalajalāseko,Sokopāyāsanāsanaṃ;Āghātasallaniddhārī,Upanāhavimocanaṃ.
Vighātapariyādāna-māsavānamasesato;Paṭipassambhanaṃ ceto-pītikaraṇacandanaṃ.
Sabbadukkhasamugghāti, sukhupaṭṭhānamuttamaṃ;Byasanodayavicchedo, bhayabheravaniggamo.
Paññāsīlasamādhānaṃ, paṭipattivisodhano;Piyaṅkaro sommabhāvo, dullabho bahupatthito.
Vihiṃsāratisārambha-paṭirodhavimocanaṃ;Verikibbisaviddhaṃsī, lokānuggahakāraṇaṃ.
Dhammapajjotakaraṇaṃ, saṃyogamalasodhanaṃ;Sammohatimiruddhāri, sampattipaṭipādanaṃ.
Akkhobho adhivāsento,Sabbānatthe parissaye;Bhīmasaṅgāmāvacaro,Hatthināgova sobhati.

Tato anīgho ekaggo, upasantamanoratho;Jhānattikaṃ catukkaṃ vā, mettācetovimuttiyā.

‘‘Khīyantu pāpadhammā ca, passambhentāmayā tathā;Saṃklesā palibodhā ca, samucchijjantu pāṇ
‘‘Vihesā ca vighātā ca, khīyantu bhayabheravā;Paṭikkamantu vissaṭṭhā, sotthiṃ passantu pāṇ
Iccevamanukampanto, sabbasattepi sabbathā;Sabbadukkhasamugghātaṃ, patthento karuṇāyati.
Karuṇānantaraṃ yogī, bhāveyya muditaṃ tato;Sattānaṃ sukhitākāramāvajjetvāna yoniso.
Devakāyā mahābhogā,Mahesakkhā yasassino;Accharāparivārehi,Paricārenti nandane.
Rājābhisekasampattā, chattacāmarabhūsitā;Ādhippaccamadhiṭṭhāya, sukhitā rājabhogino.
Yathopaṭṭhitabhogehi, tadaññepi ca pāṇino;Yathākāmitanipphannā, modanti sukhapītikā.
Caturāpāyikā sattā, pāpakammaparikkhayā;Tato cutābhinandanti, sukhaṭṭhāne patiṭṭhitā.
Sabbālayasamugghātaṃ, patvā lokuttaraṃ padaṃ;Paṭipassaddhadarathā, sukhaṃ modantanappakaṃ.
‘‘Bhayamaggamatikkantā, dukkhasaṅghāṭanissaṭā;Khemamaggamanuppattā, pītisampattiphullitā.
Iti sammā pihāyanto, sukhādhigamasampadaṃ;Sattānamabhirocento, muditāya samaṃ pharaṃ.
Hitvā palāsābhisaṅgaṃ, issāratiniraṅkato;Mettāyamiva pāpeti, muditājhānamappanaṃ.
Ahaṃ ko nāma ke cete, kimaṭṭhānabudhantaro;Paresupari pekkhanto, vihaññāmīti attano.
Iti saṅkhāyupekkhanto, hitakāmopi pāṇinaṃ;Apakkhapātupekkhāya, samaṃ pharati yoniso.
Appamaññā catasseva-mācikkhi vadataṃ varo;Mahāpurisadhorayho, hitakāmo mahāmuni.
Attani mitte majjhatte, veriketi catūsupi;Karonto sīmasambhedaṃ, sabbattha samamānaso.
Appamāṇālambaṇattā, tathā suppaṭipattiyā;Sattesu appamāṇattā, appamaññāti sammatā.
Iccābhivuddhimicchanto, dukkhāpagamanaṃ tathā;Samiddhe anumodanto, upekkhanto ca pīṇite.
Mātāva dahare putte, gilāne yobbane ṭhite;Sakiccapasute ceva, catudhā sampavattati.

Paṇḍiccaṃ paramatthesu, pāṭavaṃ paṭipattiyaṃ;Patthayantena bhikkhūna-mitthaṃ sugatasāsane.

Asaṅkhāraṃ sasaṅkhāramiti bhinnaṃ punaṭṭhadhā;Kāmāvacarakusalaṃ, kāme sugatisādhakaṃ.
Itthaṃ bhūmivibhāgena, kusalaṃ tu catubbidhaṃ;Ekavīsāpi bāvīsaṃ, sattatiṃsavidhampi vā.
Asaṅkhāraṃ sasaṅkhāramiti bhinnaṃ punaṭṭhadhā;Lobhamūlaṃ pakāsenti, lobhamohadvihetukaṃ.
Dosamūlaṃ pakāsenti, dosamohadvihetukaṃ;Vicikicchāsahagataṃ, uddhaccasahitanti ca.
Upekkhāvedanāyuttaṃ, momūhaṃ duvidhaṃ pana;Mohamūlaṃ pakāsenti, mohenevekahetukaṃ.
Pañcadvāramanodvāra-vasena duvidhaṃ pana;Upekkhāvedanāyuttaṃ, kriyāvajjananāmakaṃ.
Itthamekūnanavuti-vidhaṃ cittaṃ bhave tathā;Ekanavutividhaṃ vā, ekavīsasatampi vā.
Takkacārapītisukhacittassekaggatāyutaṃ;Sotāpattimaggacittaṃ, paṭhamajjhānikaṃ mataṃ.
Tatheva sakadāgāmimaggacittañca pañcadhā;Rāgadosamohattayatanuttakaramīritaṃ.
Kāmadosasamugghātakaraṃ niravasesato;Tatiyānuttarañcāpi, kusalaṃ pañcadhā tathā.
Saṃyojanānaṃ sesānaṃ, samugghātakaraṃ paraṃ;Catutthānuttaraṃ maggacittaṃ pañcavidhanti ca.
Cattāri pañcakāneva, maggesu ca phalesu ca;Sesāni cekāsītīti, ekavīsasataṃ bhave.
Pāpāhetukamuttāni, anavajjāni sabbathā;Ekūnasaṭṭhi cittāni, puññapākakriyāvasā.

Rūpapākā mahāpākā, manodhātu ca tīraṇaṃ;Rūpaṃ janenti ekūnavīsati netaradvayaṃ.

Ekacittakkhaṇā hoti, yāvajīvaṃ tato paraṃ;Bhavaṅgaṃ pariyosāne, cuti cekakkhaṇā bhave.
Paṭisandhi bhavaṅgañca, ekamevekajātiyaṃ;Cuti cārammaṇañcassa, evameva yathārahaṃ.
Satteva ṭhānasaṅkhepā, pañcadvārikamānasā;Catupaññāsa sabbepi, vitthārena sarūpato.
Nātitikkhe nātisīghe, nātitejussade jave;Samamandappavattamhi, tadārammaṇamicchitaṃ.
Tadeva vītarāgānaṃ, kriyā nāma pavuccati;Avipākatamāpannaṃ, vaṭṭamūlaparikkhayā.
Tatrāpi sukhitajavaṃ, sukhitadvayato paraṃ;Upekkhitamhā sambhoti, upekkhekaggatāyutaṃ.
Nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa, upariṭṭhaphaladvayaṃ;Pañcābhiññā tathā maggā, ekacittakkhaṇā matā.
Paṭhamāvajjanaṃ pañca-dasannaṃ parato bhave;Dutiyāvajjanaṃ hoti, ekavīsatito paraṃ.
Ekamhā pañcaviññāṇaṃ, pañcamhā sampaṭicchanaṃ;Sukhasantīraṇaṃ hoti, pañcavīsatito paraṃ.
Ekūnasaṭṭhito rūpa-pākā pākā arūpino;Kamāṭṭhacattālīsamhā, tathekadvitihīnato.
Pubbasaṅgahamiccevaṃ, vigaṇetvā vicakkhaṇo;Parasaṅgahasaṅkhyādiṃ, vibhāveyya visārado.
Santīraṇā dvihetumhā, pākā dvādasa jāyare;Tihetukāmapākamhā, ekavīsati labbhare.
Paṭighamhā tu satteva, sitamhā teraseritā;Pāpapuññadvihetumhā, ekavīsati bhāvaye.
Kāmapākamanodhātu-hasituppādamānasā;Dosamūlāni maggo ca, rūpajjhānāva sabbathā.
Sukhatīraṇavoṭṭhabba-parittajavanā pana;Ekatiṃsāpi jāyante, chasu vīthīsu sambhavā.
Ekadvārikacittāni, pañcachadvārikā tathā;Chadvārikavimuttā ca, vimuttāti ca sabbathā.
Chārammaṇesu hontīti, aṭṭhadhā tividhā puna;Ekārammaṇacittāni, pañcachārammaṇāni ca.
Ekaticcatukoṭṭhāsagocarā tividhā pana;Samasaṭṭhi tathā vīsa, kamenekādaseti ca.
Ito paraṃ pavakkhāmi, bhūmipuggalabhedato;Cittānaṃ pana sabbesaṃ, kamato saṅgahaṃ kathaṃ.
Nirayañca tiracchānayoni petāsurā tathā;Caturāpāyabhūmīti, kāme duggatiyo matā.
Tathārūpacutā honti, tatthevoparimeva ca;Vaṭṭamūlasamucchedā, nibbāyanti anāsavā.
Yāni paññāsa vassāni,Manussānaṃ sa piṇḍito;Eko rattidivo tena,Māseko tiṃsa rattiyo.
Taṃ navutivassasata-sahassaṃ pana piṇḍitaṃ;Gaṇanāya manussānaṃ, catubhāgūparūpari.
Koṭittayaṃ saṭṭhisatasahassañcādhikaṃ bhave;Gaṇanāya manussānaṃ, tāvatiṃsesu piṇḍitaṃ.

Suddhāvāsamapāyañca, hitvāsaññibhavaṃ tidhā;Sotāpannādayo dvepi, sesaṭṭhānesu labbhare.
